creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: A shimmering fog of illusions that hides my team and makes enemies swing at ghosts
environmentalInteractions: Stealth-field fighters compound with the veil: their opening strikes come from targets that are doubly hard to pin.
Enemies inside swing at afterimages — a 15% accuracy penalty on everything they attempt within the fog.
Anchoring the veil over your own backline lets fragile supports and artillery work behind moving false silhouettes.
sideEffects: The stealth bonus only helps allies who are actually stealthed — a team with no stealth kits gets only the accuracy denial.
Asymmetric by design and priced accordingly: it is a field, so there is nothing for the enemy to destroy — but also nothing stopping them walking out.
counterplay: Step outside the 12 m fog and force the fight in clear air — the illusions do not follow.
Wait out its 60-second duration before committing your heaviest cooldowns.
Use area abilities: blast radii do not care which silhouette was real.
visualManifestation: A knee-to-shoulder bank of opaline fog in which half-real duplicates of everyone inside walk half a step out of sync.
audioManifestation: Soft glassy chimes and doubled footsteps arriving a half-beat after the real ones.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: concealment/illusion field archetype.
